s.how: Toss 600g peeled king prawns with 3 crushed garlic cloves, 1 chopped chilli, the zest and juice of a lime and 2 tbsp oil. Thread onto skewers and grill over hot coals for 90 seconds a side. Serve with lime wedges.

s.note: Reagan, Nixon, Carter and Johnson masks optional
s.how: Cut 100g each of sharp cheddar, Monterey Jack, colby and smoked provolone into wedges and line them up on a board like the four masks. Add 1 box crackers and 2 sliced apples and leave out for 20 minutes before serving.

m.how: Whisk 150g flour with 250ml cold lager. Dip 500g flathead strips and fry at 180C for 3 minutes. Mix 150g sour cream with 1 chipotle and lime juice. Serve in 12 warm tortillas with shredded cabbage, diced tomato and onion, and the crema.

w.how: Split 4 bananas lengthways into four dishes. Add a scoop each of vanilla, chocolate and strawberry ice cream. Melt 100g dark chocolate with 100ml cream for fudge. Top with fudge, sliced strawberries, whipped cream, chopped nuts and a cherry.

d.how: Bury eight 355ml bottles of Mexican lager in a cooler full of ice for an hour. Push a wedge of lime into the neck of each bottle just before handing it over. Drink it by the fire.
